name: What documents are needed to start the process of selling a probate home?

mainEntity.name: What documents are needed to start the process of selling a probate home?

acceptedAnswer.text: To begin selling a probate home, you'll typically need documents such as the Letters Testamentary or Letters of Administration, which prove the personal representative's authority. Other essential documents include the death certificate, a copy of the will (if one exists), and property deeds. Gathering these documents efficiently is a key preparation step that helps avoid delays in listing and selling the property. We work closely with clients to ensure all necessary paperwork is in order for a smooth transaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: To sell a probate home, you'll need Letters Testamentary/Administration, the death certificate, the will (if any), and property deeds to establish authority and ownership.
